Description: This recall involves CHE-US magnetic stick figure toys. The robot-shaped toys were sold in sets of five or 10 purple, blue, yellow, red and green stick figures. Each stick figure has four small magnets, one in each hand and foot. “X004N3MGCB” is printed on the back of the product packaging.
Title: CHE-US Recalls Magnetic Robot Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys

Images.Caption: Recalled CHE-US Magnetic Robot Stick Figures

Retailers.Name:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from April 2025 through August 2026 for between t $9 and $18.
Guangzhou Shian Trading Co., Ltd., dba CHE-US/CHESLICR, of China.

Hazards.Name: The recalled magnetic stick figures violate the mandatory standard for toys because when pulled apart, the figures’ arms and legs liberate high-powered magnets posing an ingestion hazard to children. When high-powered magnets are swallowed, the ingested magnets can attract each other, or other metal objects, and become lodged in the digestive system. This can result in perforations, twisting, and/or blockage of the intestines, blood poisoning and death.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the stick figures immediately, take them away from children and contact CHE-US for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to send a photo of the toys in the trash to CHE-USMagneticRobotToysRecall@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

Description: This recall involves Cipton-branded bicycle helmets. They were sold in white and in youth size small (S), fitting a head circumference of about 19.7 to 21.3 inches. The helmets have black padding, black straps, black buckle and a built-in, multi-colored LED light strip. Model “CPSK300CC” is printed on a label on the inside of the helmet.
Title: Cipton Recalls Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Head Injury; Violate Mandatory Standard for Bicycle Helmets
ConsumerContact: Cipton at 888-588-1629 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at Reply@customersupport123.com, or online at Southerntelecom.com/recall-2026-11-19 or Southerntelecom.com and click “Recall” at the top of the page for more information.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Dicks Sporting Goods and JC Penny nationwide and online at Dickssportinggoods.com from April 2024 through May 2026 for about $35.

Distributors.Name: Hardline Group, dba Cipton, of Brooklyn, New York

Hazards.Name: The recalled helmets violate the mandatory safety standard for bicycle helmets because the helmets do not comply with the impact attenuation, positional stability and certification requirements. The helmets can fail to protect the user in the event of a crash, posing a serious risk of injury or death due to head injury.

Remedies.Name:
Consumers should stop using the helmets immediately and contact Cipton for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the helmet by cutting the straps and writing in permanent marker “Recalled” on the helmet and send a photo of the destroyed helmet to Reply@customersupport123.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product. 


Note: Do not throw this defective lithium-ion battery or device in the trash, the general recycling stream (e.g., street-level or curbside recycling bins), or in used battery recycling boxes found at various retail and home improvement stores. Defective lithium-ion batteries must be disposed of differently than other batteries, because they present a greater risk of fire. Your municipal household hazardous waste (HHW) collection center may accept this defective lithium-ion battery or device for disposal. Before taking your battery or device to a HHW collection center, contact it ahead of time and ask whether it accepts defective lithium-ion batteries. If it does not, contact your municipality for further guidance.

Description: This recall involves Fidlock Hermetic dry bags. The medium-sized, watertight plastic bags are clear and measure about 8 inches tall by 4.6 inches wide. They have a blue closure strip with magnets at the top and a black lanyard. “Fidlock” is printed in white on the front of the strip and lot number 2409140930201 is on the back. “Hermetic” is printed on the product packaging.
Title: Fidlock GmbH Recalls Hermetic Dry Bags Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion Hazard
ConsumerContact: Fidlock USA toll-free at 888-303-8332 from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET, Monday through Friday, email at recall_2608@fidlock.com, or online at www.fidlock.us/pages/recall or www.fidlock.us and click on “More Recall Information” for more information.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Sports, water sports and outdoor stores nationwide and online at Fidlock.us and Amazon.com from January 2025 through September 2026 for between $30 and $35.

Hazards.Name: The recalled bags’ adhesive closure strips can detach, causing the magnets to fall out, posing a risk of serious injury or death from a magnet ingestion hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the bags immediately and contact Fidlock USA to receive a replacement bag or a gift card for the Fidlock USA online shop. Customers who purchased the product from the FIDLOCK online store can receive a full refund in the form of a credit card refund or PayPal refund. Consumers will be asked to go to www.fidlock.us/pages/recall and send a photo of the product. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

Title: Hultafors Group North America Recalls Lighted Portfolios, Angle Locators, Calipers and Calculators Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Button Cell Batteries
ConsumerContact: Hultafors Group North America toll-free at 877-722-7026 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at HultaforsGroup7307@sedgwick.com or online at www.HG2026.expertinquiry.com.

The CLC Lighted Portfolio and Johnson Level 7” Digital Angle Locator and Ruler were sold at Lowe’s Home Improvement, Menards, W.W. Grainger, True Value Hardware and other hardware stores nationwide and online at Amazon.com from March 2024 through November 2026 between $45 and $55.

Hazards.Name: The various trade tools violate the mandatory safety standard for consumer products with button cell and coin batteries because the button batteries can be accessed easily by children, posing an ingestion hazard. Additionally, the packaging and product do not have the warnings required under Reese’s Law. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death.

Remedies.Name:
Consumers should stop using the recalled trade tools immediately, place them in an area inaccessible to children and contact Hultafors Group North America. To obtain a refund, consumers will be asked to upload a photograph of the product at  www.HG2026.expertinquiry.com and certify that the product has been disposed of and will no longer be used. Upon verification, consumers will receive the retail price, as shown in table below in the form of a virtual Visa gift card. The virtual Visa gift card may be redeemed at any establishment that accepts Visa.

Note: Button cell batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures.

Description: This recall involves outdoor Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Fire Pits and Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits. The units have a “77” logo on the front, a Lot Code sticker in the center of the base, a round black sticker marked “CHINA” with a 5-digit code, the letters KS-CY or KS-FC, and a date code in YYYY-MM-DD format. The Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Fire Pits feature a small cylindrical concrete body with a removable snuffing lid and an open burn chamber at the top. The Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits feature a steel base and tempered‑glass side panels.
Title: Allstar Recalls Sharper Image Tabletop and Infinity Fire Pits Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Burn and Fire Hazards
ConsumerContact: Allstar toll-free at 855-215-5032 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at allstarmarketing6861@sedgwick.com  or online at www.firepitrecall.expertinquiry.com or www.allstarmg.com and click on “Fire Pit Safety Recall” at the bottom of the page for more information.

Products.Name: Sharper Image Tabletop Fire Pits and Sharper Image Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits

Injuries.Name: The firm has received four reports of ignited fuel escaping from the unit during use, resulting in four injuries including third and fourth degree burns to multiple body parts.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Ace Hardware, Burlington, Home Depot, Lowe’s, Kohl’s, Marshalls, Nordstrom, Rite Aid, Target, TJ Maxx, Walgreens, Walmart and other retailers nationwide, and online, including Amazon.com and Hsn.com from January 2023 through June 2026 for between $30 and $50.

Importers.Name: Allstar Marketing Group, LLC, of Winston-Salem, North Carolina

Hazards.Name: Ignited flammable liquid can escape from the recalled fire pits or trigger flame jetting from the fuel containers, posing a risk of serious injury from burn and fire hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled fire pits immediately and contact Allstar for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to register at www.firepitrecall.expertinquiry.com, write “RECALLED – DO NOT USE” in permanent marker, and submit three photographs following the instructions on Allstar’s recall page. After registration is confirmed, consumers should dispose of any remaining fuel in accordance with local hazardous-waste requirements and discard the recalled fire pits safely.
